description: List contacts. Optional search (first/last name, email), account_id (main organisation), category (category name, case-insensitive) or category_id, label (name or id), stale_days (last activity older than N days), order_by: last_activity|name|created (default last_activity). Returns category name, last_activity_at and labels[].

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for paging)

stale_days.description: Only contacts whose last activity is older than this many days

name: list_contacts
